before.title: Tidewater - a tiny tide-table library
blocks: A tiny, dependency-free library that predicts tide times from harmonic constants. It runs in browsers, in Node and on small boards.
- Predictions for any harbour with published constants
Install the package, load the constants for your harbour and call predict with a date range. The result is a list of high and low waters.

after.title: Tidewater: know the sea before you go
blocks: # Know the sea before you go
Tidewater turns published harbour data into tide tables, current maps and safe launch windows for paddlers, divers and sailors.
Pick a harbour on the map, choose your craft and see the hours when the water suits you.
The same engine is available as a library and a command-line tool.
Join the forum to share local knowledge about tricky bars and races.
